# Palette v0.4, round 2: Azure and Azure gold-first (asks 11, 12 and the round-2 preset colours)

**Two options, both generated by `palette.py` from the logo's hue. I recommend Azure. Reply "Azure" or "Azure gold-first".**

- **What changed after review.** An independent review found that round 1's P1 still looked like 12A, that its blue was not the most vivid mark, that P2 was neither a rectangle nor hopeful, and that four chart faults had been missed. Round 2 answers all of that (section 3).
- **The main changes:**
  - The hero is now an azure blue, and it is the most vivid mark on every chart.
  - The saving is one labelled block.
  - C3 puts every option on the same baseline as InfraVana.
  - The C10 lines have colour keys.
  - The phone chart puts each row name above a full-width bar.
- **Your browser pass is still needed.** Every picture is the real app with real ECharts charts, but rendered headless.

All figures are invented placeholders, not quotes. Nothing in `mock/src`, `mock/public` or `spec.md` was changed.

| InfraVana fill / text / button | `#0065b0` / `#005798` / `#004479` | the same |
| Today: comparator | `#5d1534` wine (paper label, 12.42) | `#b28439` gold (ink label, 5.07) |
| Today: options 1, 2, 3 | `#892e2c` brick, `#a1592a` sienna, `#b28439` ochre | `#5d1534` wine, `#892e2c` brick, `#a1592a` sienna |
| Saved fill / figure | `#319379` / `#1e6250` teal | the same |
| Paper, surface, ink | `#f7f4ef`, `#fcfaf6`, `#1d1c19` | the same |

| **Most vivid mark first (absolute OKLCH C)** | **InfraVana 0.142**, brick 0.125, sienna 0.112, ochre 0.107, wine 0.107, saved 0.099 | **InfraVana 0.142**, then the same five colours in new roles |
| Distance from 12A, role by role (CIEDE2000) | comparator 3.8, InfraVana 5.9, saved 4.5, options 4.6 / 6.7 / 4.5 | comparator **46.5**, InfraVana 5.9, saved 4.5, options **20.8 / 21.2 / 18.9** |
| **What you give up** | The exact logo hue for the brand blue (an 18° move). The warm Today bars still cover more of each chart than the blue. The Today hues stay close to 12A's: the visible change is the hero, the chart composition and the restyle. | The comparator no longer reads as the heaviest baseline. The darkest bars now sit on the least important rows. The gold comparator needs an ink label. |

**Why I recommend Azure:**
- The hero now looks like the hero: InfraVana is the most vivid mark, and the only cool, clear note on the chart.
- The page keeps the warm, earthy register you preferred in 12A.
- Gold-first is the bolder choice if you want the chart to look visibly unlike 12A. Its top pair, gold against azure, is a sunrise warm-cool pair, but it puts the heaviest colours on the least important rows.

**Why the hue structure stays close to 12A.** It is forced, not chosen. Four Today bars that must each reach 3:1, plus the vision gates (CIEDE2000 ≥ 10 under three deficiencies, in both simulation conventions), admit only one structure:
- a dark-to-light warm Today ladder, wine to ochre;
- a blue hero;
- a green or teal saving.

The proof is in section 6. The triad, the analogous scheme, a hero at the logo's exact hue, and the reviewer's light-Today probes all fail. So the options differ in the hero, the composition and the order of the ladder, not in the hue scheme.

## 2. Method: every value from rules (`palette.py`)

1. **Logo hue.** `sample_logo.py` reads `mock/public/logo.jpeg` (125,476 ink pixels): median OKLCH L 0.557, C 0.038, h 231.9°. **Base hue: 232°.**
2. **Colour space.** OKLCH. Out-of-gamut values keep their L and h and lose C.
3. **Hue offsets from 232°:**

   | Role | Offset | Hue |
   |---|---|---|
   | InfraVana and its text, button and hover shades | +18 | 250° |
   | Saved | −60 | 172° |
   | Today rungs | +127, then steps of 26 | 359°, 25°, 51°, 77° |
   | Paper, rules, ink | +213 | 85° |
   | Section accent (the complement) | +180 | 52° |
   | Notice amber | −142 | 90° |
   | Presets, dusty violet | +68 | 300° |
   | Presets, clay | +180 | 52° |

   - **Why the hero moves 18°.** At the logo's own hue, sRGB holds at most C 0.102 at L 0.5. A Today ladder capped under that turns brown and fails tritanopia (9.4; `R-petrol`). At 250° the blue reaches 0.142.
   - **Earth tones in Today.** The rungs run in natural order: dark at the red end, light at the yellow end. The middle rungs are earth tones (sienna, ochre). Round 1's "no brown" claim was wrong.
4. **Lightness ladders (OKLCH L), equal steps.**
   - **Today rungs:** 0.33, 0.435, 0.54, 0.645 (steps of 0.105).
   - **Brand:** 0.50, 0.45, 0.38, 0.30.
   - **Saved:** fill 0.60, text 0.45.
   - **Chrome:** paper 0.968, surface 0.985, muted 0.935, grid 0.905, border 0.865, strong border 0.62, secondary 0.47, ink 0.225.
   - **Presets:** 0.62, 0.55, 0.48, 0.41, 0.34.
   - **Notice:** fill 0.965, border 0.45, text 0.40.
5. **The chroma rule, in absolute OKLCH C.**
   - **InfraVana:** the sRGB maximum at its own L and h (0.142).
   - **Every other mark:** the smaller of its share of the sRGB maximum at its own L and h (Today 80%, Saved 85%) and **0.88 × InfraVana's C (0.125)**.
   - **Result:** InfraVana is the most vivid mark by absolute chroma, in both options.
   - **Chrome:** absolute values. Paper 0.007, ink 0.006, rules 0.012, selected tint 0.022. Section accent, presets and notice: 0.06 to 0.09.
6. **Roles.**
   - **Today comparator and options 1 to 3:** one ladder rung each, always with a direct label. Option 4 is not drawn: Today is capped at your default of four bars.
   - **InfraVana:** the brand ladder.
   - **Saved:** one block, labelled "Saved $X".
   - **Label inside a bar:** paper if it reaches 4.5:1, else ink.
   - **Selected state:** a brand tint plus a 2px brand-text edge.
   - **Section accent:** chrome only.
7. **Gates** (`python3 -I -B palette.py --check` exits 1 if any fails for an offered option):
   - **WCAG 2.x:** text 4.5:1, marks and borders 3:1. There are 66 pairs, covering paper and surface, chart chips, the C10 wash, the notice, and every preset tick and button edge.
   - **CIEDE2000 ≥ 10** between every two of the six fills: normal vision, and Machado (2009) deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia, applied **in linear sRGB and in gamma sRGB**.
   - **InfraVana is the most vivid mark.**
   - **Chrome stays clear of the data:** notice, dusty-violet presets and section accent are each ≥ 10 from every chart fill.
8. **Usage rules** (new; the spec should carry them):
   - **Charts, thumbnails and the grid view sit only on the paper or surface fills, never on `surface_muted`.** On muted, ochre falls to 2.77 and saved to 3.10.
   - **The disabled-text token (`#888682`, 3.31:1) is for `:disabled` controls only.** All four goal tabs are enabled, so no tab uses it.
9. **Compiled output matches.** I built the scratch app and read the compiled CSS. Each option's block holds exactly the 34 hex values in `generated/tokens.css`, none missing and none extra.

## 3. Review findings and what was done

| # | Finding | Done |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Round 1's P1 was 12A again to the eye | Dropped. The hero is now azure (`#0065b0`, CIEDE2000 5.9 from 12A's blue and visibly brighter), and the chart composition changed (section 5). Gold-first moves the Today roles 19 to 47 from 12A. **One part I keep:** the Today hues stay near 12A's because the structure is forced (section 1). |
| 2 | "InfraVana most vivid" held only in relative chroma | The rule is now in absolute C (2.5). InfraVana 0.142 ranks first in both options. |
| 3 | P2 was not a rectangle | P2 is dropped. The options are now named for what they are. |
| 4 | Round-2 presets not reconciled | `04-presets.png`. Recommended: dusty violet at chrome chroma (16.5 to 24.9 from every chart fill, 3.40 to 10.98 on paper). Alternative: clay, which is 9.7 from sienna and so could read as a chart series. |
| 5 | C3 staircase | Every option is a bar on the same baseline as InfraVana. I used equal bar groups rather than a dot plot, because they keep the bar language of the other charts. |
| 6 | C10 tangle, split saving, cramped phone | (a, b) A colour swatch keys each end label, and each line ends in its own marker at a staggered x. (c) One "Saved $45.9K" block, with the two sources in the tooltip and the benefit boxes. (d) At 390, the row name sits above a full-width bar. |
| 7 | "No brown" claim was false | Withdrawn. The Today ladder is called earth tones. |
| 8 | Amber notice too close to option 3 | The notice family is generated at 90°: border `#695205`, 18.8 from the nearest fill; text `#584503`, 21.3; fill `#fdf3d9`. |
| 9 | Marks fail on `surface_muted` | Rule 2.8: charts sit on paper or surface only. The failing values are reported in checks.md. |
| 10 | Disabled text at 3.31 | Rule 2.8: `:disabled` only. |
| 11 | P2 fails under the gamma convention | Both conventions are now gates. Both offered options pass: smallest 10.1, tritanopia gamma. |
| 12 | InfraVana and saved closest under tritanopia | The saving is labelled. The pair is 10.7 (linear) and 10.1 (gamma), above the gate. |
| 13 | Clay accent at 10.05 from sienna | Kept, at 10.1, above the gate. |
| 14 | A diagnosis mark covered a label | Moved. Marks 13 to 16 were added and checked at full size. |
| 15 | Stale "STEP 5" on the intake | Now "Step 5 of 6", with round 2's labels. |

## 5. The charts: 16 faults and their fixes (`01-diagnosis.png`, `chart-look.patch`)

| # | Fault | Fix (ECharts option or CSS token) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Slab bars (58% of the row) | `barWidth` 24px |
| 2 | Broken y axis rule | `yAxis.axisLine.show: false` |
| 3 | Every row name bold | Bold only for the compared pair |
| 4 | Outlined, framed savings | `--chart-separator-width: 2px` paper gaps, no outlines |
| 5 | Today louder than InfraVana | Absolute chroma rule (2.5) |
| 6 | Heavy budget line | 1px, secondary ink (6.20:1) |
| 7 | Bold end labels | Rich text: quality in secondary ink, the figure bold |
| 8 | Accent reads as data | Chrome chroma, 10.1 from the nearest bar |
| 9 | C3 slabs against dots | Bars 13% wide, at most 44px |
| 10 | Uneven hue rhythm | Equal ladders |
| 11 | Ringed C10 points | 6px points without a ring, a 3px frontier, a 10% brand wash down to the best Today line |
| 12 | Thin C10 lines | 2px |
| 13 | Split, unlabelled saving | One "Saved $45.9K" block; the parts in the tooltip and the benefit boxes; the row label adds "$45.9K saved" |
| 14 | C3 marker staircase | Every option a bar on the shared baseline; the HTML key shows bar swatches |
| 15 | C10 unkeyed, tangled lines | A swatch in each end label, staggered end markers |
| 16 | Cramped phone chart | Row name above a full-width bar (`axisLabel.show: false`, label at `[0, -4]`); rows 84px |

**About `chart-look.patch`:**
- It is a diff against the v0.4 proposal scratch copy, `design-v04/work/src`, as of round 2, and applies with `patch -p1`. It is not a patch to `mock/src`.
- The look switches on with `?look`. The palettes switch on with `?pal=AZ|AG` (add `&ramp=clay` for clay presets).
- It also picks each inside label's colour by contrast, which the gold comparator needs.

| Round-1 P2 "Rectangle" | Not a rectangle (the 332° vertex was empty); scarlet read as alarm; InfraVana the least vivid mark; protanopia 6.9 in the gamma convention |
| Hero at the logo's exact hue (`R-petrol`) | Capped under 0.102, Today turns brown; tritanopia 9.4 |
| Triad (`R-triad`) | Protanopia 8.1 (gamma 6.2); saved label 4.38 |
| Analogous (`R-analogous`) | Tritanopia 2.8; saved fill 2.88 on paper |

## 7. For the brand owner: what the accent change means

- **The brand colour moves.** It goes from today's `#466577` (and round 1's `#006c93`) to **`#0065b0`**:
  - hue 250° instead of the logo's 232°;
  - chroma 0.142 instead of the logo's 0.038.
- **The logo file is not changed.** The logo stays a muted steel blue. The site's accent becomes a clearer azure of the same blue family, and it is used for InfraVana's marks, the brand text, links of the brand and the primary button.
- **The new blue is visibly different from the logo.** CIEDE2000 between the new blue and the logo's median colour is 14.3; for `#006c93` it is 11.3. Neither matches the logo, because the logo is far greyer than any accent that can carry the charts.
- **To sign off:**
  1. Accept an accent 18° bluer and more saturated than the logo.
  2. Spec 12.4 and 14.1 then record `#0065b0` and its ladder (`#005798`, `#004479`, `#002f56`, tint `#dfebf8`).
- **If not signed off:** the fallback is the logo hue, but then InfraVana cannot be the most vivid mark with four Today bars that pass the vision gates (`R-petrol`).

## Files

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `colour.py` | sRGB, WCAG, OKLab and OKLCH, CIELAB, CIEDE2000, Machado simulation (linear and gamma); standard library only |

| `palette.py` | Every rule and parameter, the offered options, the dropped and rejected sets, and every gate |
| `generated/tokens.css` | The CSS overrides each option loads (`html[data-pal="AZ"]`, `"AG"`, plus `[data-ramp="clay"]`) |
| `generated/palettes.json`, `generated/checks.md` | Every value and check |
| `chart-look.patch` | The chart restyle and composition, as a patch to the v0.4 scratch copy |

To regenerate: `cd mock/docs/design-v0.4/palette && python3 -I -B sample_logo.py && python3 -I -B palette.py --check`.
